run_evaluate: run evaluation of an OrienterNet model on a dataset split with optional sequential mode and visualization output
run_evaluate_single_image: run single image evaluation on a dataloader with a GenericModule model and optional GPS fusion metrics
run_evaluate_sequential: run sequential evaluation on a dataset using RigidAligner or GPSAligner for trajectory-based pose estimation
resolve_checkpoint_path: resolve a checkpoint file path from an experiment name or pretrained model identifier with automatic download support
review_pretrained_models: review the pretrained_models dictionary to find available OrienterNet checkpoint names and their configuration overrides
